summary: Round 8 testing completed. All 9 backend tests passed. Fixed checkout redirect bug. All Round 8 features verified: OrderConfirmationPage, checkout redirect, review with order_id and image_urls.

order_confirmation_page_route.details: /confirmation/:orderId route exists in App.js (line 146-152) and OrderConfirmationPage renders correctly

checkout_redirect_to_confirmation.details: CheckoutPage.js now redirects to /confirmation/{orderId} after successful payment. Fixed race condition where fetchCart() caused redirect to /panier

confirmation_page_shows_order_details.details: Confirmation page shows: order number, items with quantities/prices, subtotal, delivery fee, total, delivery date/slot, address

confirmation_page_email_notification.details: Shows 'Email de confirmation envoyé' message with user email

review_creation_stores_order_id.details: POST /api/reviews accepts order_id field, stored in review document

get_reviews_by_order_id.details: GET /api/reviews/order/{orderId} returns product_reviews with image_urls field

product_reviews_display_image_urls.details: CataloguePage.js lines 486-491 display review.image_urls as images in product detail modal

review_form_photo_upload.details: OrderTrackingPage.js lines 361-376 handle photo upload via FileReader to base64 data URL

review_form_photo_preview_delete.details: OrderTrackingPage.js lines 380-403 show photo preview with delete button

frontend_compiles.details: Frontend compiles without errors, ESLint passes on CheckoutPage.js

bug_fixed.issue: Checkout redirect to confirmation page not working - redirected to /panier instead
bug_fixed.root_cause: Race condition: After order creation, fetchCart() was awaited before navigate(). This updated cart state to empty, triggering useEffect dependency on cart.minimum_reached which redirected to /panier
bug_fixed.fix_applied: Changed 'await fetchCart()' to 'fetchCart()' (non-blocking) and moved navigate() before fetchCart() call

success_rate.frontend: 100% (all features verified via UI testing and code review)

seed_data_creation: Multiple test orders created during testing
context_for_next_testing_agent: Round 8 features all implemented and tested: 1) OrderConfirmationPage at /confirmation/:orderId shows order number, items, totals, delivery info, email notification, track order and my orders links. 2) Checkout redirects to confirmation page after payment (fixed race condition bug). 3) Reviews store order_id field. 4) GET /api/reviews/order/{orderId} returns reviews with image_urls. 5) Review form in OrderTrackingPage has photo upload with preview and delete button. 6) Product detail in CataloguePage displays review image_urls. Photos stored as base64 data URLs (MOCKED - no real upload server).
